: ...and when the morning sun shone through their windows, it turned the cobwebs into silver and gold. And from that point on, the widow and her children would never have to live in poverty again.
lines.zh: : ……而当清晨的阳光透过他们的窗户，蜘蛛网便化作了银与金。从那以后，那位寡妇和她的孩子们再也不必生活在贫穷之中。

lines.en: : This folktale, referred to mostly as “The Legend of the Christmas Spider,” dates back to the 1800’s and is thought to be conceived in either Ukraine, Germany, or Poland.
lines.zh: : 这个民间故事通常被称为「圣诞蜘蛛的传说」，可追溯到 19 世纪，据信起源于乌克兰、德国或波兰中的某一处。

lines.en: : For this reason, combined with old European superstitions stating that destroying a spider’s web is bad luck, seeing spiders or spiderwebs on Christmas is now thought to bring {i}good{/i} luck instead.
lines.zh: : 正因如此，再加上欧洲古老的迷信认为破坏蜘蛛网会带来厄运，如今在圣诞节看到蜘蛛或蛛网反而被认为是会带来{i}好{/i}运的。

lines.en: : Wow. And to think we got this whole lecture just because Noriko refused to step on a spider and had to {i}bring it outside{/i} instead.
lines.zh: : 哇。想想看，我们听这么一长串讲解，只是因为 Noriko 不肯踩死一只蜘蛛，非得{i}把它拿到外面去放生{/i}。

lines.en: : Don’t mock me, Kirin! I’ve brought good luck to our dorm room for the next year!
lines.zh: : 别嘲笑我，Kirin！我给咱们宿舍带来了一整年的好运！

lines.en: scene calendardays4
: Anyway, I guess I should start taking attendance now. Who decided to not show up today?
lines.zh: : 总之，我想我该开始点名了。今天谁没来？

lines.en: : Ami and Sensei are-
lines.zh: : Ami 和 Sensei 没——

lines.en: : Correction — who decided to not show up that is {i}normally here?{/i}
lines.zh: : 更正一下——是{i}平时会来的{/i}那些人里，谁没来？

lines.en: : Rin! But I only know this because she owes me 5,000 yen from a bet and not because I still like her. Which I don’t.
lines.zh: : Rin！不过我知道这个，只是因为她打赌欠了我 5000 日元，不是因为我还喜欢她。我并没有。

lines.en: : Chika ain’t here either. Somethin’ about...actually, I got no fuckin’ clue. She just ain’t here.
lines.zh: : Chika 也没来。好像是因为……实际上我他妈一点头绪都没有。她就是没来。

lines.en: : Great. Well, I guess just fuck around until lunch or whatever. I’m not really in the mood to teach today.
lines.zh: : 好极了。那你们就随便混到午饭时间什么的吧。我今天实在没心情上课。

lines.en: : Miss Imai, I have a question.
lines.zh: : Imai 老师，我有个问题。

lines.en: scene calendardays5
: No, Touka. I’m not raising the Secret Santa spending limit again. You already talked me into 10k and even that is way too much for a bunch of mostly-unskilled teenagers.
lines.zh: : 不行，Touka。我不会再提高秘密圣诞老人的消费上限了。你已经说服我提到一万日元了，对一群基本没什么技能的青少年来说，那都已经太夸张了。

lines.en: : It’s not that. I was just wondering if you are doing okay. You’ve seemed rather...off these last few days.
lines.zh: : 不是这个。我只是想问问你还好吗。你最近几天看起来有点……不对劲。

lines.en: scene calendardays6
: Yeah, well...you’d be off too if your best friend and coworker just decided to shirk all his responsibilities and vanish without so much as a goodbye.
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧……如果你最好的朋友兼同事突然决定甩掉所有责任、连句再见都不说就消失，你也会不对劲的。

lines.en: : Vanish? I was informed that the Herald of the Adolescents was merely under the weather. No one mentioned anything about vanishing.
lines.zh: : 消失？我听说的只是那位「青少年的先驱」身体不适而已。没人提过什么消失。

lines.en: : He may as well have vanished. None of us have heard shit from him since Halloween.
lines.zh: : 他跟消失了也没两样。自万圣节之后，我们谁都没收到过他半点消息。

lines.en: : Ami still...comes to school sometimes, though...and she always-
lines.zh: : 可 Ami 还是……有时候会来学校……而且她总是——

lines.en: : Aaaaaah! All this long division stuff is killin’ me! I ain’t got any idea what’s goin’ on with Sensei, but bring back the teacher who didn’t make me do any schoolwork!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！这些长除法要了我的命！我不知道 Sensei 到底怎么了，但把那个不让我做作业的老师还回来！

lines.en: : If anyone needs me, I’ll be at my desk.
lines.zh: : 谁要是找我，我就在办公桌那儿。

lines.en: scene calendardays7
: Poor Imani ain’t taking this whole Sensei situation very well, is she?
lines.zh: : 可怜的 Imani 对 Sensei 这事接受得不太好，是吧？

lines.en: : You say that like someone who hasn’t also spent the last month and a half crying over him.
lines.zh: : 你这话说得，好像过去一个半月里没为他哭过一样。

lines.en: scene calendardays8
: You know, you’d be crying too if you hadn’t upped all your dosages just to compensate for the sudden lack of...male conversation.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你要不是把药量全加了上去，好补偿突然缺失的……男性对话，你也会哭的。

lines.en: : Probably! Modern medicine sure is neat, isn’t it? Want to share? That worked out really well the last time I tried it.
lines.zh: : 大概吧！现代医学真了不起，不是吗？要分我一点吗？上次我试的时候效果可好了。

lines.en: : No, Io. I don’t wanna {i}share.{/i} I wanna get our friggin’ teacher back before the whole class falls apart.
lines.zh: : 不，Io。我不想「{i}分{/i}」。我想在整班散架之前，把我们那该死的老师弄回来。

lines.en: scene calendardays9
: Me too. But it’s starting to look like the only way we’ll be able to do that is by tracking him down and breaking into wherever he’s staying.
lines.zh: : 我也是。可现在看来，唯一的办法就是找到他，然后闯进他住的地方。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure he’s just at his house. That’s how Ami’s made it sound at work at least. But no matter how many times I ask her if I can come visit him, she keeps turning me away.
lines.zh: : 我挺确定他就在自己家里。至少 Ami 在店里说话的口气是这样。可不管我问多少次能不能去看他，她都不让我去。

lines.en: : She did pretty much the same for me the one time I asked about him.
lines.zh: : 我有一次问起他，她也差不多是这么对我的。

lines.en: scene calendardays10
: You actually, like...{i}talked{/i} to her? With your mouth?
lines.zh: : 你真的……跟她{i}说过话{/i}？用嘴？

lines.en: : No, Uta. I learned sign language for the sole purpose of communicating with her.
lines.zh: : 不，Uta。我专门为了跟她交流去学了手语。

lines.en: : You joke, but I wouldn’t put that sorta thing past you.
lines.zh: : 你在开玩笑，但这种事我可不觉得你做不出来。

lines.en: : Fair point. But yes, I {i}did{/i} talk to her. With my mouth. For maybe five whole seconds.
lines.zh: : 说得有道理。不过是的，我{i}确实{/i}跟她谈过了。用嘴。大概整整五秒钟。

lines.en: : Desperate times call for desperate measures, and you’re obviously not the only person around here currently going through Sensei-withdrawal.
lines.zh: : 非常时期行非常之事，而眼下显然不止你一个人在经历「Sensei 戒断反应」。

lines.en: : And I think I speak for everyone when I say I want him back as soon as possible.
lines.zh: : 而且我想，我能代表所有人说一句：我想让他尽快回来。

lines.en: scene calendardays11
: God, what a jerk! Just imagine what sorta chaos the maid cafe would fall into if {i}I{/i} stopped coming to work every single day! Like, be considerate of others, Sensei! Come on!
lines.zh: : 天啊，真是个混蛋！想象一下，要是{i}我{/i}每天都不去上班，女仆咖啡店会乱成什么样！拜托，为别人想想啊，Sensei！真是的！

lines.en: : Maybe we really should just break in? We can pool the money we make from our jobs to pay for whatever fine we’ll get slapped with for the attempt.
lines.zh: : 也许我们真该直接闯进去？我们可以把打工挣的钱凑起来，付掉因为这次闯入而吃的罚单。

lines.en: scene calendardays12
: I’m pretty sure we’d just get sent to juvie. Or jail. And it’s not like you can just pay your way out of those places.
lines.zh: : 我挺确定我们会被送进少管所。或者监狱。而且那种地方可不是花钱就能出来的。

lines.en: : Yes you can. That’s quite literally what bond is.
lines.zh: : 可以的。保释金说白了就是干这个的。

lines.en: : No. A bond is that thing you and I have that explains why we like each other. A {i}bribe{/i} is a thing you have to pay somebody to get ‘em to do stuff.
lines.zh: : 不是。bond 是我和你之间那种解释我们为什么喜欢彼此的东西。{i}贿赂{/i}（bribe）才是你得付钱给别人、让他们办事的东西。

lines.en: : You know, sometimes I forget that you’re kind of dumb. But then you go and say things like that and it all comes rushing back.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我有时会忘了你其实挺傻的。可你一说这种话，我就全想起来了。

lines.en: : At least if we get arrested, I might be able to see my brother. It’s been a while.
lines.zh: : 至少要是被抓了，我也许能见到我哥。好久没见了。

lines.en: scene black
: Have him teach you more about the justice system when you do, please.
lines.zh: : 到时候请让他多教教司法系统的事，拜托了。

lines.en: scene calendardays13
: ...and that’s why you should sign my petition to create more safe injection sites in the downtown area!
lines.zh: : ……所以你应该在我的请愿书上签字，呼吁在市中心增设更多安全注射点！

lines.en: : You {i}do{/i} realize you’re talking to the daughter of a junkie, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你在跟一个瘾君子的女儿说这话，对吧？

lines.en: scene calendardays14

: No, I didn’t actually. You never tell anybody about yourself. And if anything, wouldn’t that make you {i}more{/i} inclined to sign the petition? Because surely you must have some idea of the dangers that-
lines.zh: : 不，我真不知道。你从来不跟任何人说自己的事。而且要说起来，那不是反而让你{i}更{/i}该签这份请愿书吗？因为你肯定多少知道那些危险——

lines.en: : Shut up. But, {i}before{/i} you shut up, why do you keep talking to me? This is supposed to be my “stand here and mind my own business” spot and you keep fuckin’ coming over every god damn day.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。不过，在你闭嘴{i}之前{/i}，你为什么老来找我说话？这本来是「我站在这儿不理人」的位置，你他妈每天都过来。

lines.en: : Well, we’re friends now, aren’t we?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们现在是朋友了，不是吗？

lines.en: scene calendardays15
: What? Fuck you talkin’ about? When the hell did that happen?
lines.zh: : 什么？你他妈在说什么？那是什么时候的事？

lines.en: : Halloween! You were the only person who knew my costume. Which means you’re into the same kind of anime that I’m into. Which means that we’re friends now.
lines.zh: : 万圣节！你是唯一一个认出我cos的人。也就是说你喜欢的那类动画和我一样。也就是说我们现在是朋友了。

lines.en: : {i}No?{/i} That ain’t how makin’ friends works, you fucking beady-eyed lunatic.
lines.zh: : {i}才不是？{/i}交朋友才不是这么回事，你这眼睛贼亮的小疯子。

lines.en: : How would you know? You don’t have any. Besides me, I mean. And Chika. But Chika’s not here right now, so I’ll keep you company and make sure you don’t get lonely.
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道？你又没有朋友。除了我之外。还有 Chika。不过 Chika 现在不在，所以我就来陪你，保证你不会寂寞。

lines.en: scene calendardays16
: Here’s a better idea — instead of devotin’ the rest of homeroom to pissin’ me off, why don’t you take your BS petition and shove it so far up your ass that even a team of surgeons won’t be able to-
lines.zh: : 我有个更好的主意——与其把剩下的班会课都用来气我，不如把你那份狗屁请愿书塞进你的屁股，塞得连一队外科医生都——

lines.en: : Attention, everyone!
lines.zh: : 大家注意！

lines.en: scene calendardays17
: {i}Please{/i} direct your attention over here for a {i}very{/i} special surprise!
lines.zh: : {i}请{/i}把注意力转到这边，有个{i}非常{/i}特别的惊喜！

lines.en: scene calendardays18
: Holy crap!
lines.zh: : 我的天！

lines.en: : What in the ever-loving fuck?
lines.zh: : 这他妈是什么情况？

lines.en: scene calendardays19
: Surprise! We switched colors.
lines.zh: : 惊喜吧！我们换了发色。

lines.en: : And I look more lesbian than ever.
lines.zh: : 而我看起来比以往更像个蕾丝边。

lines.en: : And {i}I{/i} am very confused. Why would you do this without asking us first?
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}很困惑。你们为什么不先问我们就这么做？

lines.en: scene calendardays20
: Why should we have to consult with you and the rest of the class if we want to change our hair colors?
lines.zh: : 我们想换个发色，凭什么非得跟你和全班商量？

lines.en: : It’s just too much at once, okay? I’m going to keep forgetting who is who and it’s gonna fuck with my methodology when it comes to flirting with you.
lines.zh: : 只是一下子变化太大了，好吗？我会一直搞混谁是谁，还会打乱我跟你搭讪的方法论。

lines.en: : Kirin, could you kindly go fuck yourself and never joke about flirting with me again? Thanks.
lines.zh: : Kirin，麻烦你去操你自己，以后别再拿跟我搭讪开玩笑了好吗？谢了。

lines.en: : Can {i}you{/i} just fuck me instead?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}能不能干脆操我？

lines.en: : I liked you more when we hated each other.
lines.zh: : 我们互相讨厌的时候我更喜欢你。

lines.en: : Kirin, the reason we switched hair colors is because {i}I{/i} was looking for a change-
lines.zh: : Kirin，我们换发色是因为{i}我{/i}想换个样子——

lines.en: scene calendardays21
: And {i}I{/i} wanted to fit in a little better with the rest of the light music club!
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}是想跟轻音部的其他人更合得来一点！

lines.en: : It would have been, like...totally weird if there was some flashy gyaru following you guys around to shows.
lines.zh: : 要是有个花里胡哨的辣妹跟着你们到处跑演出，那也太怪了。

lines.en: : Now, you have a cool rocker chick slash...semi-gyaru...thing. I don’t know! I’m having an identity crisis!
lines.zh: : 现在嘛，你们有个酷酷的摇滚妹兼……半个辣妹……什么的。我也不知道！我正在经历身份危机！

lines.en: : And it has nothing to do with me going stir crazy from not seeing my significant other in almost two months!
lines.zh: : 而且这跟我快两个月没见到我那位「另一半」、快要憋疯了毫无关系！

lines.en: : Hahah! Significant other!
lines.zh: : 哈哈！另一半！

lines.en: scene calendardays22
: I remember when I had one of those.
lines.zh: : 我记得我也有过那么一位。

lines.en: scene calendardays23
: Oh, sorry. Was I supposed to react to that?
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我需要对此有什么反应吗？

lines.en: scene calendardays24
: Maybe!
lines.zh: : 也许需要！

lines.en: : My bad. But I’m not really sure how I’m supposed to respond to that very obviously pointed statement.
lines.zh: : 我的错。不过我真不知道该怎么回应那句明显在指桑骂槐的话。

lines.en: : Well...neither am I!
lines.zh: : 嗯……我也不知道！

lines.en: : You’re...not sure how to respond to your {i}own{/i} statement?
lines.zh: : 你……不知道该怎么回应你{i}自己{/i}说的话？

lines.en: : I said what I said! It doesn’t need to make sense!
lines.zh: : 我说都说了！不需要有道理！

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : Well, see you at band practice I guess.
lines.zh: : 那好吧，社团练习见。

lines.en: : Yeah! I guess!
lines.zh: : 好！那就这样！

lines.en: : I see not much has changed on the breakup front, has it?
lines.zh: : 看来分手这组没什么进展啊，是吧？

lines.en: scene calendardays25
: Leave it alone, Nodoka. Rin and Otoha decided on their separation mutually, so it’s best if we don’t get ourselves involved with any of the-
lines.zh: : 别管了，Nodoka。Rin 和 Otoha 是双方同意分手的，所以我们最好别掺和进任何——

lines.en: : If you miss having someone to put your fingers inside of, I wouldn’t mind experimenting with you. As a friend, of course.
lines.zh: : 如果你想念有人让你把手指伸进去的感觉，我不介意跟你试试。当然，是以朋友的身份。

lines.en: scene calendardays26
: Why do I even bother talking anymore?
lines.zh: : 我为什么还要开口说话啊？

lines.en: : Are you going to tell me that every single day for the rest of my life, Nodoka? Because I’m really starting to believe you are.
lines.zh: : 你打算这辈子每天都跟我说这个吗，Nodoka？因为我真的开始相信你是认真的了。

lines.en: : There is a very simple way to shut me up, you know.
lines.zh: : 有个很简单的办法能让我闭嘴，你知道吗。

lines.en: : I’m good. But thanks.
lines.zh: : 我不用。不过谢了。

lines.en: scene calendardays27
: I have not benefited nearly as much from this separation as I should have.
lines.zh: : 我在这场分手里得到的好处，远没有我该得的那么多。

lines.en: : Wh...Why {i}did{/i} you and Rin...decide to break up again?...I thought you two looked...nice together...
lines.zh: : 为……为什么你和 Rin……又决定分手了？……我还以为你们俩看起来……很般配……

lines.en: : We told you guys at the last band meeting — it was getting in the way of my music. If I want to get better, I can’t be splitting my time between a girlfriend {i}and{/i} singing. I needed to choose one.
lines.zh: : 上次社团会议我们跟你们说过了——那在妨碍我的音乐。如果我想进步，就不能把时间分给女朋友{i}和{/i}唱歌两边。我得选一个。

lines.en: : But...doesn’t it hurt?...Knowing you used to be...you know...
lines.zh: : 可是……不会痛吗？……知道自己曾经是……你知道的……

lines.en: : Not really. I don’t think either of us expected it to last forever. We’re just teenagers, you know? Things like this happen all the time.
lines.zh: : 其实不会。我觉得我们谁都没指望它能天长地久。我们只是十几岁的孩子，你知道吗？这种事常有。

lines.en: : I...I see...
lines.zh: : 我……我明白了……

lines.en: scene calendardays28
: You sound rather disheartened at the passing of this tryst, Miss Sakakibara. Would you care to explain why? Or shall I assume you were just longing to be {i}involved{/i} to some extent?
lines.zh: : 听你这语气，对这段露水情缘的消逝还挺失落的嘛，Sakakibara 小姐。不知你愿不愿意解释一下？还是说我该假设你也「{i}想参与{/i}」其中几分？

lines.en: : Involved?...What does that mean?
lines.zh: : 参与？……那是什么意思？

lines.en: scene calendardays29
: Ahh...the way she feigns such innocence never fails to captivate me so. I can already feel the creative juices beginning to drip down my thighs.
lines.zh: : 啊……她佯装天真无邪的样子总是让我如此着迷。我已经能感觉到创作的汁液开始顺着大腿往下淌了。

lines.en: : I think that might be something else.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那大概是别的东西。

lines.en: : Say...do you guys think Sensei will turn up to the Christmas party this year?
lines.zh: : 话说……你们觉得 Sensei 今年会出现在圣诞派对上吗？

lines.en: scene calendardays30
: Do {i}you?{/i}
: I...hope so...
lines.zh: : 我……希望会……

lines.en: : This has been...the longest I’ve gone without seeing him since...the two of us met...
lines.zh: : 这是……自我们相遇以来，我最长一次没见到他……

lines.en: : I think there’s a chance he shows up, right? Like...he’s never missed one before. And some fresh air would probably be good for him. Assuming he isn’t already getting any.
lines.zh: : 我觉得他还是有可能会来的吧？毕竟他以前从没缺席过。而且换换新鲜空气大概对他有好处。当然，前提是他现在还没呼吸到什么新鲜空气。

lines.en: : If I didn’t know any better, I might assume you were actually {i}worried,{/i} dearest roommate.
lines.zh: : 如果我不知情的话，我大概会以为你是真的在{i}担心{/i}呢，亲爱的室友。

lines.en: : Could it be that your maternal instinct is finally taking root? Or perhaps Onee-sama simply longs for the taste of her honorary younger brother’s-
lines.zh: : 难道是你的母性本能终于生根了？还是说 Onee-sama 只是渴望尝一尝她那名义上的弟弟的——

lines.en: : Fuck off, Nodoka. I just want to check in on the guy, that’s all. And I know you all do as well. So why do {i}I{/i} have to be the one to say it out loud?
lines.zh: : 滚蛋，Nodoka。我只是想去看看那家伙，就这样。而且我知道你们也都想。那为什么非得由{i}我{/i}把话说出口？
